blocks.text: American actress Gwyneth Paltrow delighted Filipino fans after she made her own versions of the Filipino dish tortang talong and the condiment banana ketchup. Paltrow documented the process through a video on her Instagram page on Saturday, Oct. 17, from grilling the eggplant and dipping it in beaten eggs to frying it. She also showed herself making the sauce from fresh bananas. “Tortang Talong with garlicky turkey crumbles and banana ketchup. A Filipino breakfast classic,” she said in the caption.
